question: According to the prophet, whose blood was the LORD avenging through Jehu?
options: The soldiers killed at Ramoth Gilead
His servants the prophets, shed by Jezebel
The people of Samaria in the famine
The men killed by the bears
explanation: The LORD told Jehu to destroy the house of Ahab to avenge the blood of His servants the prophets shed by Jezebel.
